How can the evaluation attribute a gain to an architectural change?

## Concepts

Specify the unit of evaluation, baseline, completion rubric, budget, and observed environment. Separate traces used to diagnose failures from aggregate comparisons [@liu2024agentbench].

## Study task

Compare fixed search with one adaptive proposal rule across several synthetic datasets, with the same proposal budget for both. Measure validation gains and final holdout error per dataset.

## Deliverable

Submit an evaluation table with per-task results, uncertainty appropriate to the sample, and one plausible confound.
